description: Olimpia — Colore: Yellow & white Codice: 5154 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Damask Scala: Large Altezza: 141 cm Rapporto: 65.5 cm × 125 cm Toni: Yellow Introduced in 1955 to commemorate the A.I.D. European Conference, OLIMPIA is a 17th-century inspired feast for the eyes. Extravagant plumes trumpet and unfurl, framing abundant cornucopias and urns flowing with fruit and flowers. So named for Mount Olympus, OLIMPIA is fit for gods and mortals alike.
